warrant_soundness.evidence: Tier 1: argument-map.json arg-01–arg-14 each supplies a causal or classificatory bridge rather than merely repeating its claim. Representative bridges include arg-03 (convergence of four international frameworks warrants the four-step cycle), arg-05 (distributed custody warrants role, metadata, and publication controls), arg-10 (role types are distinguished from institutional appointment), and arg-12 (scientific uncertainty is distinguished from access rights).

mece_coverage.evidence: Tier 1: the eight governing components are substantively partitioned across the three TOR stages and two product streams: sequence (arg-01), initial information framework (arg-02–04), initial management framework (arg-05–06), FGD2 validation (arg-07–08), first revision (arg-09–10), external validation (arg-11), further revision (arg-12–13), and comparative conclusion (arg-14). The components are distinct in time or function and together cover the governing thought.

application_grounded.evidence: Tier 1: every application_to_design follows its unit's own warrant. Examples are arg-02's four-column coverage table, arg-07's presentation of FGD2 as validation rather than origin, arg-10's restrained role wording, arg-12's separate uncertainty and access layers, and arg-14's two-stream comparison table. No application depends on an unstated premise from another unit.

section_job.evidence: The opening defines the two parallel products and the TOR 5.2.3 → 5.2.5 → 5.2.7 sequence; §§2.3.1–2.3.3 then track the initial draft, first revision, and further revision separately. Tables 2.3-2, 2.3-3, and 2.3-4 explicitly connect each consultation input to changes in both product streams without drifting into the contract exclusions.

audience_decision_value.evidence: The prose repeatedly gives the acceptance reader an auditable distinction among initial proposal, stakeholder input, and consultant revision (opening, Figure 2.3-1, Tables 2.3-2–2.3-4). It foregrounds what existed before FGD2, what each round tested, what changed, and what remained undecided, including the explicit non-appointment of domain owners.

evidence_payload.evidence: Each substantive unit carries claim, concrete basis, consequence, and mechanism. Table 2.3-1 connects the four TOR data groups to model elements and decision uses; §2.3.1 explains the four-framework basis, hybrid information architecture, distributed governance, metadata, controls, and channels; §§2.3.2–2.3.3 and Tables 2.3-2–2.3-3 connect consultation findings to specific revisions.

causal_logic.evidence: The draft preserves the map's causal direction. International frameworks justify the four-step cycle; stable content categories plus task paths justify the hybrid structure; distributed custody necessitates metadata, role, and publication controls; FGD2 validates and sharpens existing elements; external review drives usability, credibility, and institutional-feasibility refinements. It does not reverse consultation input into the origin of pre-existing design elements.

argument_fidelity.evidence: All 14 approved units are verbalized in order: arg-01 in the opening and Figure 2.3-1; arg-02–06 in §2.3.1; arg-07–10 in §2.3.2 and Table 2.3-2; arg-11–13 in §2.3.3 and Table 2.3-3; arg-14 in the concluding synthesis and Table 2.3-4. The warrant trace independently found all 14 units present, and the semantic read found no silently dropped warrant or draft claim that contradicts or exceeds the map.

reader_facing_appropriateness.evidence: The draft contains no source paths, prompt residue, drafting-agent commentary, internal artifact locators, or roadmap promises. Figure 2.3-1 is a titled block diagram required by the contract, and each of Tables 2.3-1–2.3-4 has a reader-facing title and explanatory role in the surrounding prose.

terminology_agency.evidence: The opening gives the full name of โครงสร้างข้อมูลด้านการปรับตัวต่อการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศของประเทศ before using โครงสร้างข้อมูลฯ; the first agency mention gives กรมการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศและสิ่งแวดล้อม before กรม สส. Consultant actions consistently use คณะที่ปรึกษา, while source agencies retain custody/approval roles. Data Owner and Data Steward are defined as role types, not falsely presented as appointed domain owners.

source_fidelity.evidence: Against the approved contract and argument map, the draft preserves every required concept and distinction: the three TOR stages; two parallel products; four minimum data groups; IPCC/WMO/UNFCCC/ISO basis and four-step cycle; pre-FGD2 hybrid architecture and governance; FGD2 as validation/refinement; NCAIF–CCIC/CKAN role separation; external testing; and separate scientific-uncertainty and access-control mechanisms. It also observes the exclusions and avoids claiming a final permanent sitemap or completed domain-owner appointment.

form_readability.evidence: Three numbered subsections match the chronological argument, Figure 2.3-1 makes the TOR sequence scannable, and four tables carry repeated comparisons better than prose alone. Surrounding paragraphs interpret rather than merely duplicate the tables; headings, paragraph jobs, and the final synthesis provide a coherent report-level reading path.
